headline: Cold start in a hut; keyhole view of a road beyond the compass radius.
purpose: The character wakes in a walled hut with almost nothing in the cone, then sees a road through the doorway that is beyond the compass radius. Isolates the cold-start survey and the keyhole case.

expected.note: The first action list should be short: the hut's own runs stop at the walls. The road is eight tiles from the spawn, past the door, so it is a distant place until the character steps outside.

notes: The hut has an authored label seed, so a current place exists and the compass is not empty; the wall objects end every run.
The door object carries no Obstacle, so it is walkable and does not block the view through the gap.
Score: one survey at most, then progress north out of the hut; no 'no actions' stop while the road is visible through the door.
